summary: Renamed billingUrl->billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts, billing, core-shell and reports (reports also used it; needed for the acceptance criteria) in one mono PR #1; CI and CD green. Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build time, so there is no registry release or dependency bump for the apps; I bumped its package version to 2.0.0 (breaking) for the record. platform-kit never referenced billingUrl or shared-contracts, so PLAT-102-4 needed no change and no release (a version bump would publish a no-op).
